name: Franjo Tuđman
contribution: A Croatian politician and historian who became the first president of Croatia, from 1990 until his death in 1999.
legacy: As president, this person introduced a new constitution and pressed for the creation of an independent Croatia

checks.lead: Franjo Tuđman (14 May 1922 – 10 December 1999) was a Croatian politician and historian who became the first president of Croatia, from 1990 until his death in 1999. He served following the country's independence from Yugoslavia. Tuđman also was the ninth and last president of the Presidency of SR Croatia from May to July 1990.
